features.title: ask_user_question tells the model that questions are markdown
features.summary: The forked ask_user_question tool keeps the upstream schema and answer encoding and only rewrites its description text: question text and option descriptions are Markdown, the first paragraph is the heading, and a ```html preview fence becomes a sandboxed HTML view with no network and no same-origin access.
failureModes: A profile whose preset-standard row still names @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user keeps the native description; the form still renders markdown, but the model is not told about it.
A model that sends a plain ```html fence gets a code block, not a page.

verification.testName: keeps the upstream schema exactly, descriptions aside
tells the model that questions are markdown with sandboxed html previews
